documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Management stated that ABS Marine Services reported a strong financial performance in FY26, with consolidated total income growing by 75.05% year-on-year to INR322.64 crores and EBITDA increasing by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores. The company expanded its fleet by inducting the offshore support vessel Artemis and plans further fleet additions and vessel dry docks. For FY27, management provided a conservative top-line growth guidance of 10% assuming vessels run in the second half. Management remains optimistic about offshore and maritime sector opportunities supported by favourable demand-supply dynamics and government initiatives. ABS Marine Services Limited reported consolidated total income of ₹322.64 Cr and net profit of ₹80.80 Cr for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

guidance.claim: Management stated that top-line growth can be expected to increase by 10% from current levels in FY27.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half. We can expect on the turnover front a 10% increase from the current levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that favourable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that ONGC is expected to come out with a tender for about 20 vessels.
demand_outlook.quote: See, demand is as of -- as we talk now, ONGC is asking for about 20-vessel tender is going to come.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that during H2 FY26, the offshore support vessel Artemis was successfully inducted into the owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they are scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated a total of about $15 million was spent for both new vessels.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated the EBITDA margin is currently in the band of 45 to 50 and that will continue.
margins_costs.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the cost of an idle vessel is approximately $1,700 a day.
margins_costs.quote: I am not -- I mean, it all depends on number of people we keep on board and how much we are burning. So, let's put it as a ballpoint figure, it's about $1,700 a day.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to healthy growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that out of the eight owned vessels, five are on long-term charter.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of the eight vessels that we own, five of them are on long-term charter, three of them -- two of them have just come out of charter, and third one is just we have acquired, so it has to go into the dry dock and then only come out and then only we put her in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the company totally owns 12 vessels, including four smaller vessels on long-term charter.
orders_capacity.quote: No, 12 number is correct. The other four vessels are smaller vessels, they are on long-term charter. They are pilot boat and security boat.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured over ₹350 Cr in strategic contracts including offshore vessel charters and port contracts.
orders_capacity.quote: Over ₹350 Cr in Strategic Contracts Secured

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the debt-equity ratio is comfortable for lenders.
capital_allocation.quote: At this point of time with our debt-equity ratio the banks are also comfortable. I don't think we have overshot on the debt side.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties, and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantee of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that a five-year contract has been signed with Hardy Oil for the vessel Hades.
management_commitments.quote: We have already got a charter with Hardy Oil for a five-year contract and...

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a commitment to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
